# Ezra Chapter 7 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 470r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/EZR_007_page_001.jpg

---

**7:1** And-after these things [ha-devarim], in-the-reign of-Artachshasta [Artaxerxes] king of-Paras, Ezra [Ezra] son of-Serayah, son of-Azaryah, son of-Chilqiyah,

**7:2** son of-Shallum, son of-Tsadoq, son of-Achituv,

**7:3** son of-Amaryah, son of-Azaryah, son of-Merayot,

**7:4** son of-Zerachyah, son of-Uzzi, son of-Bukki,

**7:5** son of-Avishua, son of-Pinechas, son of-El'azar, son of-Aharon the-priest the-chief [ha-kohen ha-rosh] —

**7:6** this Ezra went-up [alah] from-Bavel, and-he [was] a-scribe [sofer] skilled [mahir] in-the-Torah [instruction] of-Mosheh which YHWH the-God of-Yisra'el had-given, and-the-king granted [natan] to-him according-to-the-hand of-YHWH his-God upon-him, all his-request [baqashato].

**7:7** And-went-up [vaya'alu] some of-the-sons of-Yisra'el, and-some of-the-priests, and-the-Levites, and-the-singers [ha-meshorerim], and-the-gatekeepers [ha-sho'arim], and-the-temple-servants [ha-netinim], to-Yerushalayim, in-the-year seven of-Artachshasta the-king.

**7:8** And-he-came to-Yerushalayim in-the-month the-fifth, which [was] the-year the-seventh of-the-king.

**7:9** For on-the-first of-the-month the-first was the-foundation [yesod] of-the-going-up [ha-ma'alah] from-Bavel, and-on-the-first of-the-month the-fifth he-came to-Yerushalayim, according-to-the-hand of-his-God the-good [ha-tovah] upon-him.

**7:10** For Ezra had-set [hekhin] his-heart [levavo] to-seek [lidrosh] the-Torah of-YHWH and-to-do [la'asot] [it] and-to-teach [u-le-lammed] in-Yisra'el statute [choq] and-ordinance [u-mishpat].

**7:11** And-this [is] the-copy [parshegen] of-the-letter that the-king Artachshasta gave to-Ezra the-priest the-scribe [ha-kohen ha-sofer], scribe of-the-words [divre] of-the-commandments [mitsvot] of-YHWH and-his-statutes [chuqqav] upon Yisra'el:

**7:12** "Artachshasta, king of-kings [melekh malkhayya], to-Ezra the-priest, scribe of-the-law [dath] of-the-God of-heaven — complete [gemir], and-now [ukh'eneth]:

**7:13** By-me a-decree is-made [sim te'em] that anyone in-my-kingdom from-the-people of-Yisra'el and-their-priests and-Levites who-volunteers [mitnadev] to-go to-Yerushalayim, with-you let-him-go [yihakh].

**7:14** Because [kol qovel di] from-before the-king and-his-seven counselors [ya'atowhi] you-are-sent [shliyach] to-inquire [le-vaqara] concerning Yehud and-Yerushalayim according-to-the-law [dath] of-your-God which [is] in-your-hand,

**7:15** and-to-bring the-silver and-gold which the-king and-his-counselors have-freely-offered [hitnadavu] to-the-God of-Yisra'el whose-dwelling [mishkeneh] [is] in-Yerushalayim,

**7:16** and-all the-silver and-gold which you-find [tihashkach] in-all the-province [medinata] of-Bavel, with the-freewill-offering [hitnadavut] of-the-people and-the-priests, freely-offering for-the-house of-their-God which [is] in-Yerushalayim.

**7:17** Therefore [kol qovel denah] promptly [osparna] buy [tiqneh] with-this-silver bulls [torin], rams [dikhrin], lambs [immerin], and-their-grain-offerings [minchathon] and-their-drink-offerings [niskeihon], and-offer-them [teqarrev himmow] upon the-altar of-the-house of-your-God which [is] in-Yerushalayim.

**7:18** And-whatever to-you and-to-your-brothers seems-good [yitav] to-do with-the-rest of-the-silver and-the-gold, according-to-the-will [ki-re'ut] of-your-God, do [ta'avdun].

**7:19** And-the-vessels that are-given to-you for-the-service of-the-house of-your-God, deliver [hashlem] before the-God of-Yerushalayim.

**7:20** And-the-rest of-the-need [chashchut] of-the-house of-your-God which falls [yippol] upon-you to-give, give from-the-treasure-house [beit ginzei] of-the-king.

**7:21** And-by-me, I Artachshasta the-king, a-decree is-made [sim te'em] to-all the-treasurers [gizbarayya] who [are] in-the-region-Beyond-the-River, that whatever Ezra the-priest, scribe of-the-law of-the-God of-heaven, requests of-you, let-it-be-done [yit'aved] promptly —

**7:22** up-to a-hundred talents [kakkerin] of-silver, and-up-to a-hundred cors [korin] of-wheat, and-up-to a-hundred baths [bathin] of-wine, and-up-to a-hundred baths of-oil, and-salt without-limit [di la ketav].

**7:23** Whatever [is] by-the-decree [min-ta'am] of-the-God of-heaven, let-it-be-done [yit'aved] diligently [adrazda] for-the-house of-the-God of-heaven, lest-there-be wrath [qetseph] upon the-realm [malkut] of-the-king and-his-sons.

**7:24** And-to-you we-make-known that concerning-any of-the-priests, Levites, singers, gatekeepers, temple-servants, or-servants of-this house of-God — tax [mindah], tribute [velo], or-toll [halakh] — it-is-not-permitted [la shalit] to-impose [le-mirme] upon-them.

**7:25** And-you, Ezra, according-to-the-wisdom [chokhemat] of-your-God which [is] in-your-hand, appoint [manni] magistrates [shaphtin] and-judges [dayanin] who will-judge [dinin] all the-people who [are] in-the-region-Beyond-the-River, all who-know the-laws [datei] of-your-God, and-whoever does-not-know — you-shall-teach [tehodun] them.

**7:26** And-whoever does-not-do [la leheve aved] the-law of-your-God and-the-law of-the-king, let-judgment be-executed [dina yit'aved] upon-him promptly, whether death [mot], or-banishment [sheroshu], or-confiscation of-goods [anash nikhsin], or-imprisonment [essurin]."

**7:27** Blessed [barukh] [be] YHWH the-God of-our-fathers who put [natan] like-this in-the-heart [be-lev] of-the-king, to-glorify [le-pha'er] the-house of-YHWH which [is] in-Yerushalayim,

**7:28** and-upon-me extended [hittah] covenant-faithfulness [chesed] before the-king and-his-counselors [yo'atsav] and-before-all the-princes [sarei] of-the-king, the-mighty-ones [ha-gibborim]. And-I was-strengthened [hitchazzaqti] according-to-the-hand of-YHWH my-God upon-me, and-I-gathered from-Yisra'el heads [rashim] to-go-up with-me.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.1-5 — Ezra's genealogy:** The genealogy traces Ezra through sixteen generations to Aaron the high priest, legitimating his priestly authority. Several generations are skipped (compared with 1 Chr 6:3-15), a common practice in Hebrew genealogies where *ben* ("son of") can mean "descendant of."

**v.6 — "a scribe skilled in the Torah":** The term *sofer mahir* marks a pivotal moment in Jewish history — the emergence of the Torah scholar as a central figure alongside (and eventually surpassing) the priest. Ezra is both priest and scribe, but the text emphasizes his scribal expertise.

**v.10 — "set his heart":** The Hebrew *hekhin levavo* ("he established his heart") describes deliberate, sustained intellectual and spiritual commitment. The three infinitives — *lidrosh* (to seek/study), *la'asot* (to do/practice), *le-lammed* (to teach) — outline the ideal pattern: study, practice, then teach.

**v.28 — "extended chesed":** The chapter shifts to first-person narration. Ezra attributes the king's favor to YHWH's *chesed* (covenant-faithfulness), maintaining the theological perspective that Persian patronage is divinely orchestrated.

*— EMET*
